plugins.name: first-pass
plugins.description: Working rules and checks that make your coding agent look around a change, not only at the lines it writes: ten questions before code, a reviewer that didn't write it, proof before anything is called done, bugs fixed as a class, your habit words mapped to real checks, and a sharpen command that rewrites a messy prompt before the work starts. Set up once for a folder of repos, or for one repo.

skills.name: fix-the-class
skills.description: Bug-fix routine that fixes the whole class of bug, not just the reported instance. Use for any bug report, failing production behaviour, monitoring alert, audit finding or review finding that does real harm (a smaller review finding goes on the item's list, as ship-check says), and whenever the same kind of bug has been seen before. Reproduces it with a failing test, names the failure class, searches the codebase for the same pattern, fixes or records every hit, and adds the rule, invariant, helper or check that stops it coming back.
headings: 6. Make it hard to do again
skills.description_zh: 对有实际影响或反复出现的缺陷修复整个错误类别：以失败测试复现、命名类别、搜索相同模式、修复或记录所有命中，并增加规则、不变量、辅助函数或检查防止复发；轻微评审项另行记录。

skills.name: habit-words
skills.description: Learns the words a user habitually writes to their coding agent that make its answers worse ("be 100% sure", "don't assume", "full review", "are you sure?", "all fine, right?"), from what they actually typed in their recent Claude Code sessions. Shows what each one does, what went wrong after it, and what to say instead, then writes the habit words block that maps each word to the checks it should trigger, so the checks run without the words. Use when asked to learn, read, refresh or review the user's habit words or prompts, "which of my words make you worse", from setup-first-pass's profile step, or when the start-of-session check says the habit words are due.
skills.description_zh: 从用户近期 Claude Code 实际输入中识别可能降低回答质量的习惯提示词，说明影响与后续问题、提出替代表达，并将词语映射到应触发的检查规则；用于学习、刷新或审阅习惯提示。

skills.name: jev
skills.description: Sets up, checks or changes the optional Jev judge, the TypeSafe decision model that ship-check asks about review findings (is this real harm, is a small one worth fixing now, what proof does a small fix need). Shows whether it is on for each repo, which key it uses, switches it on or off, and sends one test request. Runs only when the user types it.
skills.description_zh: 设置、检查或调整可选 Jev/TypeSafe 判断模型，供 ship-check 评估审查项实际影响、轻微问题是否立即修复及所需证据；显示各仓库状态与所用密钥、切换启停并发送测试请求，仅在用户明确调用时运行。

skills.name: premortem
skills.description: Run before writing or changing code for any feature, bug fix or refactor that touches data, jobs, money, outside services or user-facing behaviour. Finds where the change will break before it is built, by walking ten named failure classes (twice, halfway, outside call, failure-is-not-empty, neighbors, endings, money, hostile user, words, scale and time) against the code, and writes the answers into the plan. Use when planning a change, when asked to "think it through", "cover the gaps", "make sure it's bug free", or before any edit to payment, publishing, deletion, auth or background-job code.
skills.description_zh: 在涉及数据、作业、资金、外部服务或用户行为的修改前预判故障，按原文列明的重复执行、半途失败、外部调用、失败非空值、相邻影响、结束状态、资金、恶意用户、文案、规模与时间等故障类别检查代码，将答案写入计划。

skills.name: review
skills.description: Reviews a change before it is merged, from little or no input. With nothing typed it reviews the branch you are on, uncommitted work included, against its base, its PR and its ticket, so a developer can check their own work before asking for review. With PR links, repo#N or a branch it reviews someone else's change the same way, several repos at once. It judges the failed CI checks and every Bugbot and reviewer comment, gets a fresh breaker review, traces every other piece of code that uses what changed, proves each finding or marks it unproven, says what the merge needs (a build, env vars, migrations, deploy order) and how to check the deploy, never posts to GitHub, and offers fixes only after the report. Runs only when the user types it.
headings: 3. What is already said about it
skills.description_zh: 合并前审查当前分支（含未提交修改）或指定 PR/仓库/分支，结合基线、工单、失败 CI 和评论，重新审查并追踪受影响代码，证明或标注未证实发现，列明构建、环境变量、迁移及部署顺序和验证方式；不发 GitHub 评论，报告后才提出修复，仅明确调用时运行。

skills.name: setup-first-pass
skills.description: Set up first-pass for a main folder that holds many repos, or for one repo. In a main folder it writes one set of working rules at the root that every session loads, a workspace map, and a section in each repo with that repo's real commands, test limits and invariants, and it lists each repo's own hooks so first-pass can run them from the main folder. In one repo it writes the rules and the section into that repo. Use when asked to set up, install, add, update or re-run first-pass, to "add the shipping rules", or when the start-of-session check says something drifted. Re-run to update.
headings: 2. Ask only what the code cannot tell you
6. A design tool on the UI repos (optional)
6a. The Jev judge (*plugin*, only if the owner has a key)
skills.description_zh: 为多仓库主目录或单仓库设置 First Pass 工作规则，建立工作区地图、各仓库实际命令、测试限制、不变量与钩子索引；用于首次安装、补充交付规则或漂移后的更新。

skills.name: sharpen
skills.description: Rewrites the prompt typed after the command before any work starts, then works from the rewrite. Splits a mixed-up message into a numbered list of asks, turns words like "be 100% sure", "cover all cases" or "don't break anything" into the checks they stand for, keeps every name, path, number and quote exactly, and stops to ask only where it would have to guess. Runs only when the user types it.
headings: 1. Read it for what the user wants
skills.description_zh: 在执行前重写命令后的提示，把混合请求拆成编号事项、将笼统保证转为具体检查，保留名称、路径、数字和引文，仅需猜测时提问；只在用户明确调用时运行。

skills.name: ship-check
skills.description: The definition of done. Run before calling any change done, fixed, verified, ready or shippable, for features and bug fixes alike. Checks the pre-mortem was answered, proves the tests fail on the old code, gets a fresh breaker review, runs CI's own checks in a clean checkout, checks the user-facing words, and writes the evidence report. Also use when asked "is it done", "is it ready", "did you verify it" or "can we merge".
headings: 2. Tests that fail on the old code
4. CI's own checks, in the clean checkout
skills.description_zh: 在宣布功能或缺陷修改完成前核对交付条件，检查故障预判、证明测试在旧代码失败、重新审查、干净检出中运行 CI 检查、核对用户文案并生成证据报告。
